confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live prices or listings were checked. Café, beer and restaurant anchors are moderately certain; July hostel and hotel rates are seasonal and least certain. Euro-denominated estimates were converted at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR from memory, not looked up. The FX figure comes from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Lisbon, which is generally pricier for dining and lodging, and adjusted down modestly for Porto. Also checked against similar mid-sized Iberian tourist cities and general Portuguese food-and-drink price norms.

anchor_basis.beer: 0.33 L draft lager at a neighbourhood restaurant (e.g. Super Bock), about €3.00
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a central café, about €2.20
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: prato do dia (dish of the day, usually with soup) at a local tasca, about €12
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three courses for two at a mid-range Porto restaurant, no drinks, about €70 total
anchor_basis.cocktail: gin and tonic at a city-centre bar, about €9.00
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house wine by the glass (about 150 ml) at a restaurant, about €4.00
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: shared 6-8 bed dorm bed in a registered hostel in July, about €34 per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room in a registered hostel in July, about €80 per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double room in a registered pensão or residencial in July, about €68 per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double room in a registered three-star hotel in July, about €150 per night
